equations.quote: The steady-state integral momentum equation through the channel
equations.form: d/dx[ iint_A (rho*u^2 + p) dA ] dx - p*(dA/dx) dx = - iint_{A_w} tau_w dA_w
equations.description: Momentum flux and pressure force balanced by lateral-surface skin friction.

equations.description: Momentum with uniform pressure in the cross-section; right-hand terms are rib friction, bottom-base friction and top-base friction.
